data.description:
Wire the production summarizer into the dispatch path.

Currently router_helpers._handle_session calls _evaluate_session_compaction with only 4 args — summarizer defaults to None. This task passes the production summarizer callable and routing estimator so decide_session_compaction can actually compact sessions.

Related: the new local Qwen3 summarizer task.
data.title: Add live Summarizer wiring to router_helpers._evaluate_session_compaction call site
